conclusions: All three variants pass the established2^-19 envelope, finite checks, source/output guards and immutable input checks. Each generated variant covers24576 dots and1572864 K16 groups, and each capture covers16384 sampled original QKV dots and2097152 groups. Every independent canonical CPU endpoint agrees with the actual GB10 BF16 reference. These repeated comparisons contain16384 unique captured endpoints, not49152 distinct inputs.

Zero-C scalar carry does not improve established-envelope admissions: captured fused/nearest-even/toward-zero counts are14122/14120/14121. Raw native BF16 disagreements are90/171/163, of which3/10/2 occur in16192 eligible dots. Tiny or out-of-range inputs remain important and cannot be accepted through this route.

Explicit carry reduces some single-group errors but does not validate any smaller coefficient. Generated2^-24/23/22 undercoverage is541224/16254/78 for fused,517975/337341/4 for nearest-even,and463495/3367/4 for toward-zero. False BF16 admissions also occur. All smaller coefficient hypotheses remain invalid, including variants that happen to pass captured endpoints.

The new TwoSum residual audit records zero FP64 addition-rounding events for every generated and captured group in this particular sample. This confirms exactness of these observed group sums, rather than assuming it from ranges. It does not establish FP64 as an arbitrary-input correctness authority; the independent wide integer groups and real GB10 endpoints remain attached.

No product dispatcher, numerical admission threshold, dependency or rounding-mode setting changes. Native diagnostics pass after replacing an SDK-absent intrinsic with its installed OCML directed-add declaration. The initial build and premature test failures are preserved and dispatch preconditions now prevent repeating that ordering mistake.

Do not promote the explicit carry route on these results. Investigate a structural interval recurrence that separates matrix-product error, canonical exponent-alignment loss and outward-rounded carry updates, preserving the existing conservative native-product coefficient and full exact fallback. Test it against generated counterexamples and original tensors before any product decision.
